event.piper_heart2.1.text: Thumb there, two fingers there, now pull. ...There. That's a D. It forgives everything. Play it loud on the way home. The road likes company.
event.piper_heart2.1.why: the chord becomes a small charm against the quiet

event.piper_heart2.1.text: Thumb there, two fingers there, now pull. ...There. That's a D. It forgives everything. Hum it tonight if the house goes too quiet.

event.piper_heart5.2.text: It ends on four notes. I never wrote them. They were just... they were in my hands. In my hands already. ...Sorry. Lamp flickered. Where was I?
event.piper_heart5.2.why: distortion as one repeated fragment; she stumbles on her own thread

event.piper_heart5.2.text: It ends on four notes I never wrote. They were just in my hands. Old notes. Somebody in Wetherell had them long before me.
event.piper_heart5.2.why: clue: Edmund's hum echoed, never named

event.piper_heart5.2.text: It ends on four notes I hum when nobody's around. I never wrote them. Ask the old-timers. Somebody hummed them first.
event.piper_heart5.2.why: hint: gives the player a person to ask

event.hall_dance.4.text: Same song, bigger room. One verse, then I step off. ...Good, a full hall. Every lamp lit, every chair taken. Nobody's out there alone tonight.
event.hall_dance.4.why: the celebration reads as shelter; warmth intact, strained

event.hall_dance.4.text: Same song, bigger room. One verse, then I step off. Funny, the whole village indoors at once. The night can keep its own company.

dlg.story.umbrella.talk.1.text: Third escape this season. It always turns up hung neatly, drier than I am. Somebody walks this fence line after dark and tidies. What do we do?
dlg.story.umbrella.talk.1.why: the tidy stranger becomes a night walker to chase

dlg.story.umbrella.talk.1.text: Third escape this season. Always hung neatly, drier than I am. Somebody's out in the rain being tidy. What do we do?

event.story_band_battle.intro.text: Two bands, one square, one polite war. Judge us, [player]. The birds quit singing this week, so somebody has to. Honest means fiddle.
event.story_band_battle.intro.why: wakefulness ladder (quiet birds) through an unaware mouth

event.story_band_battle.intro.text: Two bands, one square, one extremely polite war. Judge us, [player]. It's been a quiet week. Somebody has to fix that. Honest means fiddle.

event.piper_heart4.intro.text: Last set tonight, and it's yours. Request anything. For once I'll even play it. Loud enough to carry you home. The lanes have gone quiet lately.
event.piper_heart4.intro.why: music as escort; locked after-line hinges untouched

event.piper_heart4.intro.text: Last set tonight, and it's yours. Request anything. For once I'll even play it. Something to hum on the walk home. Humming helps.
event.piper_heart4.intro.why: mild: a habit, not a fear

event.piper_heart6.intro.text: Down here. The cellar. I'm not hiding. The barrels don't watch, and lately the whole room watches. ...Nerves. They're very supportive, the barrels.
event.piper_heart6.intro.why: her stage fright brushes the village's watching, unexplained

event.piper_heart6.intro.text: Down here. The cellar. I'm not hiding. I'm resting my nerves among the barrels. They don't stare. Audiences stare. Barrels are better.

dlg.piper.fright.0.text: A hundred people, no blinking, every Friday. Tonight they'll notice. They'll notice the trick. ...The playing's real. The rest is volume. Tell me the volume holds.
dlg.piper.fright.0.why: one repeated clause as distortion; confession job intact

event.piper_heart8.intro.text: Pull a chair up by the stage. New song, and not alone this time. Lately the quiet has a tune of its own. I want ours louder.
event.piper_heart8.intro.why: edges the unexplained refrain without naming it

event.piper_heart8.intro.text: Pull a chair up by the stage. New song, and not alone this time. Quiet's been pushy lately. Company writes better anyway.

event.piper_heart10.intro.text: Tonight we play the song we wrote. I'll start it. After the first verse, I step off. Don't let me climb back on. And stay till the last note. It's a staying kind of night.
event.piper_heart10.intro.why: she asks the player to stay; warm, strained

event.piper_heart10.intro.text: Tonight we play the song we wrote. I'll start it. After the first verse, I step off. Don't let me climb back on. Big rooms are kind on nights like this.

event.piper_friend.intro.text: Friday! The parsnip ballad, all four verses. One's about the gray cat, Sharp. It won't come in tonight. Sits outside, facing the wood. Critics.
Friday! The parsnip ballad, all four verses. One's about the gray cat, Sharp. It skipped tonight. First Friday ever. Everyone's a critic.

event.piper_partners.after.text: {if choice:courtship.piper.song}Your name's in the bridge. The bridge is the best part. That's not an accident.{else}{if choice:courtship.piper.duet}We sang the chorus together, and the room came in behind us. I forgot to play for a bar. Worth it.{else}Under the stars, I hummed. You hummed back. Something in the eaves hummed third. We walked faster, laughing. Mostly laughing.{/if}{/if}
event.piper_partners.after.why: walk branch only: echoes the hummed-back thread without repeating it

event.piper_partners.after.text: {if choice:courtship.piper.song}Your name's in the bridge. The bridge is the best part. That's not an accident.{else}{if choice:courtship.piper.duet}We sang the chorus together, and the room came in behind us. I forgot to play for a bar. Worth it.{else}Under the stars, I hummed. You hummed back. The night leaned in to listen. Best audience I've ever had.{/if}{/if}
event.piper_partners.after.why: mild: the night listens, nothing answers

event.overheard_wren_piper_3.l2.text: Soft, I can do. No words. The four notes, then. Wren always goes still for those.
event.overheard_wren_piper_3.l2.why: clue: a Keeper recognizes Edmund's notes; Piper only notices

event.overheard_wren_piper_3.l2.text: Soft, I can do. No words. Just the old hum, for the stool and the last light.

adds.text: ...Hey. You're white-knuckling a friendly chord. Rough day out there? Stay for the slow set. On the house.
adds.why: unaware comfort fills the cut joke's silence

adds.text: Funny thing about those four notes. Hum them walking home and the night gets very attentive. ...Owls, probably.
adds.why: a chase: hum them and listen; works at mild and full

cuts.why: the I'm-fine joke lands cruel on a frightened player; paired add fills it

threads.hall_dance: Why is the whole village so glad to be indoors together, every lamp lit?
threads.story_umbrella: Who walks the fence line after dark, tidying a stranger's umbrella?
threads.story_band_battle: Where did the birdsong go, that two bands must fill a square?
threads.piper_heart4: Why does the walk home from the saloon need a tune now?
threads.piper_heart6: Is the audience the only thing in Wetherell that watches without blinking?
threads.piper_heart8: What tune is the quiet carrying, that Piper wants theirs written louder?
threads.piper_heart10: When the room sings without Piper, what else keeps time?
threads.piper_friend: What does Sharp see toward the wood that is worth missing a Friday?
threads.piper_birthday: None; kept warm on purpose as contrast.
threads.piper_courtship: None; romance stays plain so the warmth anchors the overlay.
threads.piper_partners: What hummed third from the eaves, and has it heard those notes before?
threads.overheard_wren_piper_3: Why does Wren go still for the four notes she never requests?
threads.overheard_piper_juno_1: None; the forge noise stays innocent.
threads.overheard_hazel_piper_1: None from my side; Hazel's pass may shade her halves.
threads.overheard_hazel_piper_3: None from my side; the hidden verse stays tender.

notes: The faint refrain in my songs is Farm.Mythos text-filter work per the bible; no scene text names it, including hall_dance.5, which I left unvaried as the cozy anchor.
piper_heart4 after-line hinges (don't ask why yet / it matters later / play it back) are locked to heart10; no variant touches that line.
heart5 four-notes variants echo the planted Edmund thread but never repeat 'the room hums them back'.
overheard_wren_piper_3 clue has Piper observing Wren's stillness only; Wren's own lines untouched, and Piper draws no conclusion.
piper_partners variants change only the walk branch; song and duet branches are word-for-word cozy.
The heart2 cut and add are a pair; if the cut is rejected, drop the add too.
